description: Neon Mythos Morph – LoRA Description Step into a world where ancient gods, heroes, and mythical creatures are reborn under the glow of neon lights. Neon Mythos Morph fuses the grandeur of classical Greek mythology with the pulse of cyberpunk and synthwave aesthetics. Marble temples glow with circuitry seams, warriors wear bronze mech-armor lined with neon tracers, and mythical beasts are transformed into radiant legends of light. This LoRA brings together ancient epics and futuristic vision : Zeus wielding neon lightning, Medusa commanding LED serpents, Achilles clashing against cybernetic titans, and cities like the Acropolis rebuilt as glowing synthwave skylines. ✨ Style features : Vibrant synthwave palette — cyan, magenta, violet, neon pink, turquoise Fusion of ancient Greek architecture, armor, and myths with cyberpunk / mech design Strong cinematic compositions with realistic textures + neon glow effects Works for characters, creatures, architecture, objects, and detailed studies 🎨 Best used for : Myth-inspired cyberpunk artworks Epic battle scenes with futuristic flair Portraits that glow with neon divinity Environments that blend ancient temples with neon skylines 💡 Tips : Use the trigger word morph_neonmythos for consistent results Works best with masterpiece, ultra detailed, photorealistic quality tags Adjust SDXL LoRA strength between 0.6–0.8 for balance of style and detail Adjust Flux LoRA strength between 0.8–1.5 for balance of style and detail Adjust IL LoRA strength between 0.4–0.8 for balance of style and detail Main trigger: morph_neonmythos Style modifier: neon, synthwave, cyberpunk Subjects / Themes: zeus, hades, athena, achilles, medusa, minotaur, cerberus, harpy, cyclops, scylla, chimera Architecture / Locations: acropolis, labyrinth, temple, harbor, underworld, city, market Objects / Weapons / Accessories: spear, sword, shield, helmet, sunglasses, runes, ornament, cart, boat, food Many more names, locations, objects are trained.
